name: Break the Blues
source:
Two men who never got to know each other finally meet, take a break from life and open up a little about their sadness.

[From [url=https://axerwan.itch.io/break-the-blues]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个素不相识的男人终于见面了，暂时脱离了生活，倾诉了自己的悲伤。

[来自[url=https://axerwan.itch.io/break-the-blues]itch.io[/url]]
